_readme: Hand-surveyed places that OpenStreetMap does not carry yet — printers, vending machines, water coolers, night shops. INTENTIONALLY EMPTY: this repo hosts no invented data. Add a row only after someone has physically checked it, then either add it here or (better) contribute it straight to OpenStreetMap so everyone gets it.

_schema.name: display name, required
_schema.cat: one of the category keys in scripts/build-data.mjs, required
_schema.anchor: EXACT name of an existing OSM feature — the build resolves the position from it and warns if it stops matching. Required; never write raw coordinates here.
_schema.desc: one line of why a student cares
